backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single high-confidence feature update to replace 'Indian learners' with inclusive 'learners worldwide' language in the Home page hero section.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short summaries describing the purpose and content of each component, page, and config file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark mode OKLCH CSS custom property tokens for colors, borders, and sidebar theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app titled 'Reema's Italian Studio' that mounts the app at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with a shared Navigation/Footer layout and five page routes: Home, Lessons, Videos, About, and Contact.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Dark-themed footer with an Italian flag accent bar, brand name, quick nav links, social media icons (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook), and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/ItalianAccent.ts: Small reusable component rendering a horizontal Italian tricolor (green/white/red) divider bar.
frontend/src/components/LessonCard.tsx: Card component displaying a lesson's icon, category badge, title, description, and a 'Start Lesson' link button.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with an Italian flag accent, brand logo, active-highlighted desktop links, and a collapsible mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Card component that renders a responsive 16:9 YouTube iframe embed with a title below it.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor via TanStack Query, using the current Internet Identity or falling back to an anonymous actor, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP blockchain, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, and defines CSS custom properties for an Italian-themed color palette with light and dark mode support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page showcasing the teacher's bio and a grid of benefits for learning Italian, using icons and styled sections.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a validated contact form (with simulated submission) and social media links for YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section, featured lesson cards, and student testimonials to promote the Italian language learning platform.
frontend/src/pages/Lessons.tsx: Defines the Lessons page with three categorized sections (Beginner, Vocabulary, Grammar), each containing hardcoded lesson data rendered via LessonCard components in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/Videos.tsx: Defines the Videos page displaying a grid of 9 YouTube video lesson cards with a header, YouTube subscribe button, and a call-to-action section linking to the channel.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom Italian-themed colors (italian-green, italian-red), display/sans font families, border radii, shadows, and plugin integrations for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for 'Reema's Italian Studio', recording architectural notes, known issues (Google Search Console incompatibility with ICP hosting), existing features, and metadata about the worldwide-targeted Italian learning site.
